summary: A caucus can finish its slate without a contested ballot when every delegate and alternate place has a nominee.
realLife: At the 2018 caucus the numbers nominated matched both the delegate places and the alternate places, so the members approved the slate by acclamation.
inGame: needs: separate seat and nomination counts.

turns.pulledBy: Nominees match the available places in both groups.
turns.what: The chair offers the full slate for approval.
turns.writesBack: Delegates and alternates leave knowing their status.

turns.what: The chair separates the contested choice from the uncontested places.
turns.writesBack: The members must decide who gets the last delegate seat.
